title: Tiered approval and simulated canary for cost-optimization recommendations
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Implement a tiered, auditable workflow to safely auto-apply Optimize recommendations (batching/caching knobs) with a preflight simulation-based canary and human approval gates. The feature must allow teams to: (1) run high-fidelity simulations of candidate config changes against sampled production traces, (2) stage gradual application across traffic segments (synthetic canaries + sampled customer traffic), (3) define metric-based pass/fail gates (latency P95, error-rate, quality regression from evals, cost delta), and (4) require configurable approvals depending on risk tier and cost delta. Console and API surfaces must expose the simulation report, suggested rollout percentages, expected cost savings, and an audit trail with who approved what and when.
acceptance_criteria: A simulation runner executes a candidate Optimize change against a representative sample of recent requests and produces a report with token-count, latency (P50/P95/P99), error-rate, model-quality diffs (via eval prompt set), and estimated cost delta.
A 'Simulated Canary' mode can be scheduled from the Console or invoked via API; it returns deterministic results and stores artifacts (trace IDs, summary) in the audit log.
Teams can define a tiered rollout policy: synthetic-canary -> 1% sampled traffic -> 10% -> 50% -> full. Each stage has configurable metric thresholds and a minimum observation window.
Automated gate evaluation halts progression and triggers notifications if any threshold breaches occur; an ops link and rollback action are surfaced to the assignee.
Approval rules route based on risk envelope (e.g., cost delta > 20% or quality-regression > 0.5% requires manager + SRE approval). Approvers and scopes are configurable via RBAC integration.
Rollback is an atomic operation with documented runbook: immediate revert to previous config, re-run simulation, and create postmortem ticket draft.
Console shows per-stage telemetry, expected vs observed cost savings, and a button to abort/rollback. All actions are recorded with user, timestamp, and diff of applied settings.
End-to-end e2e tests and a canary test harness run in CI, exercising both simulated and live-sample stages with synthetic workload generators.
Performance: simulation job for a 24h sample completes within configured SLA (default 30m) for up to 1M requests sampled; live staged rollout adds <25ms median overhead to routing path.
Security review completed for audit storage and approval flow integration with SSO; KMS keys used for sensitive artifacts where required.
Documentation: developer API spec, Console UX copy, and an ops runbook are published in Confluence with links in the ticket comments.
